correctness.rationale: Inclusion-exclusion gives δ(a,b)=g(a+b)−|E∩(E+av)∩(E+(a+b)v)|, whose integrand counts occupied endpoints and a missing intermediate point, hence δ≥0. Fubini/Tonelli and change (r,a,b)↦(ell,x,r) with unit Jacobian map positive gaps to ell<x<r; integrating occupied lower/upper endpoints gives exactly ∫_{R\E_y}L_y(x)R_y(x)dxdy. Finiteness follows from bounded directional extent. Vanishing forces fibers to contain their essential interval spans modulo null sets. For interval fibers the adjacent-gap union formula is elementary and integrates by slices; continuity of translated L1 indicators gives rational-gap sufficiency. Between α and 1−α quantiles, αm≤L≤(1−α)m, so LR≥α(1−α)m², and a two-interval separated-gap example saturates. No false implication to global convexity from one direction.
